mentions.name: clojure-multiproject-example
mentions.description: A repo organisation system providing structure, conventions, and tools for sharing common parts (libraries as functions, apps as objects) across multiple projects without monolithic frameworks.
mentions.problem: Keeping shared code as distinct artifacts across projects normally leads to the diamond dependency problem and other development-time friction — the Expression Problem as it manifests in source code management for cross library, service, and project feature development.
mentions.source_excerpt: Except, it's just a repo organisation system (structure, conventions, and tools) that lets me share common "parts" across multiple "projects". No monolithic frameworks here.

evidence.value: Except, it's just a repo organisation system (structure, conventions, and tools) that lets me share common "parts" across multiple "projects". No monolithic frameworks here.
